# Evaluation results (generated by `python -m app.eval.run report`; do not edit by hand)

Benchmark `coding`: the `coding` branch's synthetic set (200 template CVs, 6 JDs, gold from its own annotation rubric; see app/eval/bench.py). Our pipeline was not developed on it. Its gold follows rules similar to its own scoring, which favours that style of ranker.

Mean over JDs with a 95% bootstrap CI over JDs. τ = Kendall's τ-b between the system order and gold grades over all 200 CVs. traps@10 = keyword-stuffed / hedged / title-inflated CVs (gold < 2) in the top 10, summed over JDs.

R@20 = share of relevant CVs (gold ≥ 2) in the top 20; MRR = 1 / rank of the first relevant CV.
